title: Grammar Drill - Articles (a / an / the)
instruction: Choose the correct article or write the missing article (a, an or the).

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: In many countries, ______ education is free for children.
questions.explanation: Danh từ không đếm được nói chung thì không dùng mạo từ.

questions.questionText: I visited ______ University of Melbourne last year.
questions.explanation: Tên riêng dạng "University of + địa danh" dùng "the".

questions.questionText: She has ______ very good chance of passing the exam.
questions.explanation: "a chance" là danh từ đếm được số ít, chưa xác định.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: She is ______ engineer who works for a software company.
questions.explanation: "engineer" bắt đầu bằng âm nguyên âm nên dùng "an".

questions.questionText: The graph shows ______ increase in the number of tourists.
questions.explanation: "increase" bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm nên dùng "an".

questions.questionText: Technology has changed ______ way we communicate.
questions.explanation: "the way we communicate" chỉ một cách cụ thể nên dùng "the".

title: Grammar Drill - Verb Tenses
instruction: Choose the correct verb form or write the missing verb form.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: The number of visitors ______ sharply between 2010 and 2020.
questions.explanation: Mốc thời gian quá khứ xác định (2010-2020) dùng quá khứ đơn.

questions.questionText: I ______ in Hanoi since 2015.
questions.explanation: "since 2015" đi với hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.questionText: If the government ______ more taxes, people would have less money.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, would + động từ.

questions.questionText: Last year, I ______ IELTS for the first time.
questions.explanation: "Last year" là mốc quá khứ xác định nên dùng quá khứ đơn.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: By the time the lecture started, most students ______ (arrive) already.
questions.explanation: Hành động xảy ra trước một mốc quá khứ dùng quá khứ hoàn thành.

questions.questionText: Scientists predict that sea levels ______ (rise) further over the next 30 years.
questions.explanation: Dự đoán về tương lai dùng "will" hoặc "be going to".

title: Grammar Drill - Subject-Verb Agreement and Noun Number
instruction: Choose the correct word or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: The number of students ______ increased.
questions.explanation: "The number of" đi với động từ số ít.

questions.questionText: Each of the candidates ______ a separate room.
questions.explanation: "Each of" đi với động từ số ít.

questions.questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ happy with the result.
questions.explanation: Với "neither...nor", động từ hòa hợp với chủ ngữ gần nhất (students).

questions.questionText: Information about universities ______ available online.
questions.explanation: "Information" là danh từ không đếm được nên dùng động từ số ít.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: Many ______ (child) in rural areas do not have access to computers.
questions.explanation: Số nhiều bất quy tắc của "child" là "children".

questions.questionText: There ______ (be) several reasons for this trend.
questions.explanation: "several reasons" là số nhiều nên dùng "are".

title: Grammar Drill - Prepositions
instruction: Choose the correct preposition or write the missing preposition.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Many students are interested ______ studying abroad.
questions.explanation: "interested in".

questions.questionText: The graph shows a rise ______ unemployment.
questions.explanation: "a rise in + danh từ".

questions.questionText: The population increased ______ 5 million to 8 million.
questions.explanation: "from ... to ..." diễn tả mức đầu và mức cuối.

questions.questionText: I depend ______ my parents for financial support.
questions.explanation: "depend on".

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: She is good ______ solving problems.
questions.explanation: "good at + V-ing".

questions.questionText: Smoking is harmful ______ health.
questions.explanation: "harmful to".

title: Grammar Drill - Complex Sentences
instruction: Choose the correct sentence or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Không dùng "but" hay "however" cùng với "although" trong một câu.

options.optionText: A. Although it was raining, but we went out.
B. Although it was raining, we went out.
C. Although it was raining, however we went out.

questions.questionText: The city, ______ has a population of two million, is the capital.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) dùng "which", không dùng "that".

questions.questionText: Which sentence has no run-on error?
questions.explanation: Hai mệnh đề cần được nối bằng liên từ như "because", không chỉ bằng dấu phẩy.

options.optionText: A. Many people prefer cities, they offer better jobs.
B. Many people prefer cities because they offer better jobs.
C. Many people prefer cities they offer better jobs.

questions.questionText: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: Hai lựa chọn còn lại chỉ là mệnh đề phụ, thiếu mệnh đề chính.

options.optionText: A. Because the road was closed.
B. The road was closed because of an accident.
C. Which caused a long delay.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: ______ he studied hard, he failed the exam.
questions.explanation: Hai vế đối lập nên dùng "although" / "though".

questions.questionText: The man ______ car was stolen called the police.
questions.explanation: "whose" chỉ sở hữu: người đàn ông có chiếc xe bị mất.

title: Grammar Drill - Punctuation
instruction: Choose the sentence or the punctuation mark that is correct.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
questions.explanation: Sau trạng từ liên kết đầu câu như "However" cần có dấu phẩy.

options.optionText: A. However I disagree with this view.
B. However, I disagree with this view.
C. However; I disagree with this view.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Không đặt dấu chấm phẩy trước "because", và không nối hai mệnh đề chỉ bằng dấu phẩy.

options.optionText: A. It is a good idea; because it saves money.
B. It is a good idea, it saves money.
C. It is a good idea because it saves money.

questions.questionText: The ______ toys are on the floor.
questions.explanation: Sở hữu của danh từ số nhiều bất quy tắc: children's.

questions.questionText: There are three main causes of stress ___ work, family and money.
questions.explanation: Dấu hai chấm dùng để mở đầu một danh sách.

questions.questionText: Which list is punctuated correctly?
questions.explanation: Các mục trong danh sách cách nhau bằng dấu phẩy, mục cuối nối bằng "and".

options.optionText: A. I like reading writing, and, speaking.
B. I like reading, writing and speaking.
C. I like, reading writing and speaking.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định được đặt giữa hai dấu phẩy.

options.optionText: A. The city, which is very old, attracts many tourists.
B. The city which, is very old attracts many tourists.
C. The city which is very old, attracts many tourists.

title: Vocabulary Drill - Word Choice
instruction: Choose the best word or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Pollution has a serious ______ on public health.
questions.explanation: "effect" là danh từ: "have an effect on".

questions.questionText: The company's profits ______ from $2 million to $5 million.
questions.explanation: "rise" là nội động từ (không có tân ngữ): rose.

questions.questionText: Many people ______ that online learning is more effective.
questions.explanation: "think that" diễn đạt quan điểm.

questions.questionText: I would like to ______ my English before the exam.
questions.explanation: "improve my English" là cách dùng tự nhiên.

questions.questionText: The exam was very ______; most students could not finish it.
questions.explanation: "difficult" mô tả độ khó của bài thi.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: We need to find a ______ to this problem. (an answer to a problem)
questions.explanation: "a solution to a problem" là cụm đúng.

title: Vocabulary Drill - Collocations
instruction: Choose the correct word or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Governments must ______ action to reduce pollution.
questions.explanation: "take action".

questions.questionText: It is important to ______ a balance between work and life.
questions.explanation: "strike a balance".

questions.questionText: Parents have a ______ influence on their children.
questions.explanation: "a strong influence".

questions.questionText: Students ______ good progress after the course.
questions.explanation: "make progress".

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: Students must ______ attention in class.
questions.explanation: "pay attention".

questions.questionText: The new policy will ______ jobs for thousands of people.
questions.explanation: "create jobs".

title: Vocabulary Drill - Paraphrasing and Avoiding Repetition
instruction: Choose the best paraphrase or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Best paraphrase of: "The number of cars increased dramatically."
questions.explanation: "increased dramatically" tương đương "rose sharply".

options.optionText: A. The number of cars rose sharply.
B. The number of cars was dropped.

questions.questionText: Best paraphrase of: "Many people think that university education is too expensive."
questions.explanation: Giữ nguyên nghĩa nhưng đổi từ và cấu trúc, không chép lại câu gốc.

options.optionText: A. A lot of people believe that going to university costs too much.
C. Many people think that university education is too expensive.

questions.questionText: Which version avoids repetition?
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ "It" và nối ý để tránh lặp "technology".

options.optionText: A. Technology is useful. Technology helps people. Technology saves time.
B. Technology is useful. It helps people and saves time.
C. Technology is useful, technology helps, technology saves.

questions.questionText: Which is the most formal way to say "a lot of" before a plural noun?
questions.explanation: "a large number of" phù hợp văn viết học thuật.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: Education is important. It is ______ for a country's development. (a stronger word)
questions.explanation: Dùng từ đồng nghĩa để tránh lặp "important".

questions.questionText: Many people live in cities. Another way to say this: Many people are city ______.
questions.explanation: "city dwellers" = người sống ở thành phố.

title: Vocabulary Drill - Spelling and Word Forms
instruction: Choose the correct spelling or write the correct form of the word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: environment (có "n" trước "m").

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: government (gov-ern-ment).

questions.questionText: Air pollution is a serious ______ to health. (threaten)
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ "serious" và mạo từ "a" cần danh từ: threat.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: successful (hai chữ "c", một chữ "l" ở cuối).

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: She is very ______ (interest) in art.
questions.explanation: Tính từ chỉ cảm xúc của người: interested.

questions.questionText: The ______ (decide) to move abroad was difficult.
questions.explanation: Cần danh từ: decision.

title: Writing Drill - Linking Words
instruction: Choose the best linking word or phrase.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Cars are convenient. ______, they cause pollution.
questions.explanation: Hai ý đối lập nên dùng "However".

questions.questionText: He studied hard, ______ he passed the exam.
questions.explanation: Quan hệ nguyên nhân - kết quả nên dùng "so".

questions.questionText: Which version uses linkers naturally?
questions.explanation: Dùng một từ nối vừa đủ, đúng chức năng; không xếp chồng nhiều từ nối cùng nghĩa.

options.optionText: A. Moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides, cars are expensive.
B. Cars are expensive. In addition, they cause pollution.
C. In conclusion cars are expensive, firstly.

questions.questionText: Online learning is flexible. ______, it can be isolating.
questions.explanation: Chuyển sang mặt trái của vấn đề nên dùng "On the other hand".

questions.questionText: Many students work part-time ______ they need money.
questions.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là một mệnh đề (they need money) nên dùng "because".

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: ______ the high cost, many people still buy cars. (two words are accepted)
questions.explanation: "Despite" / "In spite of" + cụm danh từ diễn tả sự nhượng bộ.

title: Writing Task 1 Drill - Overview
instruction: Read the line graph description, then answer the questions.

content.passageTitle: Line graph: students on two types of course (thousands)

paragraphs.text: The line graph shows the number of students (in thousands) on online courses and on classroom courses at a college between 2000 and 2020. Online courses: 2000 - 2; 2010 - 8; 2020 - 20. Classroom courses: 2000 - 15; 2010 - 14; 2020 - 9.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is an overview (main trends, no detailed numbers)?
questions.explanation: Overview nêu xu hướng chính, không liệt kê số liệu chi tiết.

options.optionText: A. In 2000, 2 thousand students took online courses.
B. Overall, online courses grew steadily while classroom courses declined slightly.
C. Online courses rose from 2 to 20 thousand.

questions.questionText: Where should the overview go in a Task 1 answer?
questions.explanation: Overview đặt ngay sau phần mở đầu hoặc trước phần chi tiết.

options.optionText: A. Only at the very end.
B. After the introduction, before the detailed paragraphs.

questions.questionText: Which overview is the best?
questions.explanation: Nêu được xu hướng chính và so sánh hai nhóm.

options.optionText: B. Online courses became far more popular, whereas classroom courses lost some students.
C. Online was 20 in 2020 and classroom was 9.

questions.questionText: An overview should NOT include:
questions.explanation: Số liệu chi tiết thuộc về các đoạn thân bài.

options.optionText: C. a detailed list of every number

questions.questionText: Which word signals an overview?
questions.explanation: "Overall" mở đầu câu tổng quan.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: ______, online enrolment increased significantly while classroom enrolment fell. (a signal word for an overview)
questions.explanation: "Overall" là từ báo hiệu overview.

title: Writing Task 1 Drill - Key Features
instruction: Read the bar chart description, then answer the questions.

content.passageTitle: Bar chart: households with internet access (%)

paragraphs.text: The bar chart shows the percentage of households with internet access in four regions in 2005 and 2015. Region A: 20% in 2005, 60% in 2015. Region B: 35%, 70%. Region C: 10%, 30%. Region D: 50%, 85%.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which sentence states a key feature?
questions.explanation: Đặc điểm chính là xu hướng chung và các mức cao nhất / thấp nhất.

options.optionText: A. Every region increased, and Region D was the highest in both years.
C. Region A starts with the letter A.

questions.questionText: Which region had the highest access in 2015?
questions.explanation: Region D đạt 85%.

questions.questionText: Which region had the biggest increase (percentage points)?
questions.explanation: Region A tăng 40 điểm phần trăm (20% lên 60%).

questions.questionText: Which detail is NOT a key feature?
questions.explanation: Màu sắc không phải thông tin dữ liệu.

options.optionText: A. the overall rise in all regions
B. the region with the lowest figures
C. the colour of the bars

questions.questionText: Which is the best key-feature sentence?
questions.explanation: Nêu được so sánh cao nhất / thấp nhất.

options.optionText: A. Region D had the highest access in both years, while Region C had the lowest.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: Region C had the ______ percentage in both years.
questions.explanation: Region C thấp nhất cả hai năm (10% và 30%).

title: Writing Task 1 Drill - Comparing Data Accurately
instruction: Read the table description, then answer the questions.

content.passageTitle: Table: monthly spending of young people (US$)

paragraphs.text: The table shows average monthly spending (US dollars) by young people on three items. Food: 200 in 2000, 250 in 2020. Transport: 80 in 2000, 120 in 2020. Entertainment: 60 in 2000, 150 in 2020.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which sentence is accurate?
questions.explanation: Giải trí tăng từ 60 lên 150, hơn gấp đôi.

options.optionText: A. Entertainment spending more than doubled.
C. Transport spending was the highest in 2020.

questions.questionText: In 2020, which item had the highest spending?
questions.explanation: Food là 250 đô la, cao nhất.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses a comparison correctly?
questions.explanation: So sánh hơn của tính từ ngắn: "higher" (không dùng "more higher").

options.optionText: A. Food spending was much more higher than transport.
B. Food spending was much higher than transport spending.
C. Food spending was more high than transport.

questions.questionText: In 2000, transport spending was ______ than entertainment spending.
questions.explanation: Transport 80 cao hơn entertainment 60.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: Spending on entertainment rose from $60 to $150, an increase of $______.
Transport spending ______ by 50% (from $80 to $120).
questions.explanation: 80 lên 120 là tăng 50%.

title: Writing Task 2 Drill - Stating Your Position
instruction: Topic: Some people think university education should be free. To what extent do you agree?

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which sentence gives a clear position?
questions.explanation: Phải nêu rõ bạn đồng ý hay không.

options.optionText: A. There are many opinions about free education.
B. I completely agree that university education should be free.
C. Some people agree and some disagree.

questions.questionText: Which phrase shows partial agreement?
questions.explanation: "To some extent" thể hiện đồng ý một phần.

options.optionText: B. I agree to some extent, but...

questions.questionText: Your introduction says "I strongly agree". Which conclusion is consistent?
questions.explanation: Kết bài phải nhất quán với quan điểm đã nêu.

options.optionText: A. In conclusion, I believe free education is unnecessary.
B. In conclusion, I reaffirm that free education benefits society.
C. In conclusion, both sides are equal.

questions.questionText: Where should you state your position in an Opinion essay?
questions.explanation: Nêu quan điểm ở mở bài và nhắc lại ở kết bài.

options.optionText: B. In the introduction and the conclusion

questions.questionText: Which phrase does NOT state your own opinion?
questions.explanation: "It is widely believed" nói về quan điểm của người khác.

options.optionText: B. It is widely believed that...

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: In my opinion, university education ______ be free.
questions.explanation: "should" diễn đạt quan điểm.

title: Writing Task 2 Drill - Answering All Parts of the Question
instruction: Topic: Why do some people choose to live abroad? Is this a positive or negative development?

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which plan answers both parts of the question?
questions.explanation: Đề có hai câu hỏi nên cần trả lời cả hai.

options.optionText: A. Only reasons for living abroad.
B. Reasons in one body paragraph; evaluation (positive or negative) in another.

questions.questionText: A student writes about the history of travel. This answer is:
questions.explanation: Không bàn về việc sống ở nước ngoài nên bị lạc đề.

questions.questionText: What is the minimum word count for IELTS Writing Task 2?
questions.explanation: Task 2 yêu cầu ít nhất 250 từ.

questions.questionText: Which essay only partly answers the question?
questions.explanation: Thiếu phần đánh giá nên chỉ trả lời một phần.

options.optionText: A. It gives reasons but never says whether this is positive or negative.
B. It gives reasons and evaluates the development.
C. It explains reasons and gives a clear view.

questions.questionText: Which first sentence is on topic?
questions.explanation: Chỉ câu đầu liên quan đến chủ đề của đề.

options.optionText: A. Many people move abroad for better job opportunities.
B. My favourite food is pasta.
C. The internet was invented in 1983.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: Writing about a different subject from the question is called going off-______.
questions.explanation: "off-topic" = lạc đề.

title: Writing Task 2 Drill - Developing Ideas
instruction: Choose the best answer or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Which sentence develops the idea "Public transport reduces pollution"?
questions.explanation: Giải thích và có ví dụ cụ thể.

options.optionText: B. For example, one bus can replace around 40 cars, which cuts exhaust emissions significantly.

questions.questionText: What is the best way to extend a main idea?
questions.explanation: Mở rộng ý bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

options.optionText: B. Explain why and give an example.

questions.questionText: Which example best supports "Online learning is flexible"?
questions.explanation: Ví dụ liên quan trực tiếp đến tính linh hoạt.

options.optionText: A. Students can watch lectures at any time, so they can work part-time.

questions.questionText: Which paragraph is underdeveloped?
questions.explanation: Đoạn đầu chỉ nêu ý, không giải thích hay dẫn chứng.

options.optionText: A. Exercise is good. Everyone should exercise.
B. Exercise improves heart health; for example, 30 minutes of walking daily lowers the risk of heart disease.
C. Exercise keeps people fit because it strengthens muscles, which also helps them avoid injuries.

questions.questionText: Which phrase introduces a result?
questions.explanation: "As a result" dẫn vào kết quả.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: To give an example, you can write "For ______" or "For instance".
questions.explanation: "For example".

title: Writing Drill - Paragraphing
instruction: Choose the best answer or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: A typical Task 2 essay has about how many paragraphs?
questions.explanation: Mở bài, 2 đoạn thân bài (có thể 3) và kết bài.

questions.questionText: Each body paragraph should contain:
questions.explanation: Mỗi đoạn thân bài triển khai một ý chính.

questions.questionText: Where does the conclusion go?
questions.explanation: Kết bài nằm cuối bài.

questions.questionText: When should you start a new paragraph?
questions.explanation: Sang ý chính mới thì xuống đoạn.

options.optionText: A. For a new main idea

questions.questionText: A 300-word essay written as a single block makes the essay:
questions.explanation: Không chia đoạn khiến bài khó theo dõi.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Complete the sentence. Write the missing word(s).

questions.questionText: Each body paragraph usually starts with a topic ______.
questions.explanation: "topic sentence" nêu ý chính của đoạn.

title: Writing Drill - Referencing
instruction: Choose the best answer or write the missing word.

questionGroups.groupInstruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.questionText: Many people use smartphones. ______ devices help them communicate.
questions.explanation: "devices" là số nhiều nên dùng "These".

questions.questionText: The government built a new bridge. ______ reduced traffic in the city centre.
questions.explanation: "bridge" là số ít nên dùng "It".

questions.questionText: Which sentence has an unclear reference?
questions.explanation: Không rõ "he", "him", "his" chỉ ai.

options.optionText: A. Tom met Ben, and he gave him his book.
B. Tom met Ben and gave Ben a book.
C. Tom met Ben and gave him a book he had bought.
